TextView.android:text:
• Hardware Keystore: Your passphrase is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The encryption key is stored in your device's Secure Element/TEE and can only be unlocked with your enrolled biometric fingerprint.

• Sensitive Clipboard: Copied passphrases are tagged with Android's sensitive content flag so clipboard previews and history won't expose your password.

• Auto-Clear: The clipboard is wiped automatically after 10 seconds (or your customized timeout).

• Quick Settings Tile: Add the 'SecurePass' tile to your Android notification shade to unlock and copy without leaving your active app.

• Samsung Galaxy Clipboard: Samsung Keyboard retains its own clipboard history tray. For maximum privacy, disable clipboard history in Settings → General Management → Samsung Keyboard Settings.
